name: MeleePad
notes: Empty app plus a game module made from the player's own disc (D11: no Nintendo keys in the published app).

steps: Open {file} and move MeleePad.app to your Applications folder.
Open MeleePad and choose your own GALE01 disc image under Game Data, then Play. If macOS asks whether MeleePad may open files in a folder, allow the one your disc image is in.
Updating? Replace the old MeleePad.app with the new one. Your saves and settings are kept.
